title: Are we getting more allergic to things?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do allergies seem more common or more visible than they were in the past?
How much should schools and restaurants adapt for people with severe allergies?
Should food labels become simpler or more detailed for allergy information?
Do people sometimes incorrectly call an intolerance an allergy, and why does the difference matter?
What changes would you make if someone in your household developed a serious food allergy?
